paragraphs: Perrone Robotics sells TONY, an autonomy kit its homepage calls vehicle-independent and designed for retrofit or turnkey deployment. The kit is sold as one that fits across manufacturers and scales to commercial, public transit, logistics, and specialty operations. The homepage also names last-mile shuttles, high-capacity buses and specialized vehicles as what the kit fits.

The products page lists turnkey passenger autonomous vehicles that are all electric, FMVSS compliant and ADA compliant with rear or side lifts, each integrated with the TONY AV Kit. Those vehicles are offered to buy or lease, and the page says a vehicle agnostic retrofit solution can be installed in any vehicle. The page adds that the turnkey solutions are outfitted in stock vehicles that are available now.
The homepage frames the offer as geo-fenced service run across downtown corridors, campuses, parks, and logistics hubs.
